title: Starshadow Modlist
body:
# ★ Starshadow Menu

### Your mods, beautifully organized.

**Starshadow Menu** replaces the default mod list with a clean, modern screen that makes browsing your installed mods a pleasure. Search, filter, view details, and jump straight into any mod's config — all from one place.

> *"Finally, a mod list that doesn't feel like a spreadsheet."*

---

## 🪄 How It Works

1. **Install the mod** and launch Minecraft
2. **Click "Mods"** on the title screen or pause menu — a new button appears automatically
3. **Browse your mods** in a clean, scrollable list with search
4. **Click any mod** to see its details, links, and config button
5. **Open config screens** with a single click — no more hunting through Mod Menu

That's it. A better mod list, instantly.

---

## ✨ Features

### 📋 Clean Mod List
A beautifully designed mod list screen with each mod displayed as a card showing its name, version, and description. Scroll through your entire modpack effortlessly.

### 🔍 Instant Search
Type to search across mod names and descriptions. Find any mod in your pack instantly, even with hundreds installed.

### 📄 Detailed Mod Info
Click any mod to see its full details in a side panel:
- Description, version, and author
- License information
- Links to website, source code, and issue tracker
- One-click config button (when available)

### ⚙️ Config Screen Discovery
Starshadow Menu automatically discovers config screens from all installed mods. Double-click a mod or hit the config button to jump straight into its settings.

### 🔘 Dynamic Button Injection
A "Mods" button is automatically added to both the title screen and the pause menu. No extra keybinds needed — the mod list is always one click away.

### 🔧 Filtering Options
Toggle whether system/builtin mods (Minecraft, Java, Mixin) are shown in the list. Keep it clean and focused on the mods you actually installed.

---

## 📥 Get It

### Recommended: Modrinth

[**Download on Modrinth**](https://modrinth.com/mod/starshadow-menu) — the preferred platform for Starshadow Menu.

### Also available on CurseForge

[**Download on CurseForge**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/starshadow-menu) — same mod, same releases.

---

## 📦 Installation

### From Modrinth (recommended)

1. Go to the [Starshadow Menu Modrinth page](https://modrinth.com/mod/starshadow-menu)
2. Select your **Minecraft version** (1.20.1, 1.20.4, or 1.21.1)
3. Click **Install** — dependencies are installed automatically if using a compatible launcher
4. Launch and click "Mods" on the title screen! 🚀

### Manual Install

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) for your Minecraft version
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Drop the following into your `mods/` folder:
   - **Starshadow Menu** `.jar`
   - **Starshadow Config** `.jar` (required dependency)
   - **Starshadow Lib** `.jar` (required dependency)
4. Launch Minecraft! 🚀

> **Supported:** Minecraft 1.20.1 · 1.20.4 · 1.21.1 — Fabric only

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Settings are accessible via the Starshadow Menu config screen, or by editing `config/starshadow-menu.json` directly.

| Setting | Default | Options |
|---------|---------|---------|
| **Show Builtin Mods** | Off | On · Off |

When "Show Builtin Mods" is off (default), system mods like Minecraft, Java, and Mixin are hidden from the list so you only see mods you've installed.

---

## 🧩 Compatibility

| Mod | Compatibility |
|-----|-------------|
| **Fabric API** | ✅ Required |
| **Mod Menu** | ✅ Compatible — both can coexist; Starshadow Menu provides its own button |
| **Starshadow Splash** | ✅ Optional — custom splash feeds into mod list |
| **Config mods** | ✅ Discovers config screens from any mod that registers them |

---

## 📋 Requirements

| Dependency | Required? |
|-----------|-----------|
| **Fabric Loader** | ✅ Yes |
| **Fabric API** | ✅ Yes |
| **Starshadow Config** | ✅ Yes |
| **Starshadow Lib** | ✅ Yes |

---

## 🌟 Your Mods Deserve a Better Home

Stop scrolling through tiny text lists. **Starshadow Menu** gives your modpack the mod list it deserves — clean, searchable, and always one click away.
